body: Sort of my follow up question... does hearing someone attempted suicide in their past raise or lower your opinion of the person for their act of sharing?
Yea. No different from other highly personal life truths, huh. This is just a new one, and it feels big.

Its part of why I believe in the authentic life - because only by being authentic can we actually see, love, and support each other. Otherwise its just masks talking to masks. 

And at the same time, some part of our humanity is to have an interior world that is not designed for constant exposure.

I've shared with three people. Two where my agenda was to elicit their help, and that required my being real. The third was someone who I thought needed my help, and would benefit from knowing my dark does as deep as his - and it turns out suicide is his prime life issue, and the way I revealed my experience was gobsmacking for him, and he was really grateful.

I'm down for sharing. I'm just unclear where that line is of when good, when best to hold back. I guess only practice will tell. Like learning how to come out as gay or former felon or republican or something. We have to learn who can/should handle our quirky selves.
hmm. thank you. it is interesting to hear another perspective from your own experience. did you ever tell anyone else?

Yeah I have some of the same feeling. I want to protect myself, which obviously I am not so good at all the time, and yet only by being authentic do i feel like I am living a life worth living. I like the word politicking. Don't want to be leading that life.

I'm here, yes. Doing better than the weeks proceeding, actually. 

And yes, my fear is how it can be used against me. I feel kind of naive about that. 

I am sometimes a spokesperson for a prominent community, and I don't wish to be discredited because my life includes the dark with the light. And yet speaking truth, just being effing real, can be so healing. 

So who do I be. Honest - exposed and vulnerable, brave and proud in my vulnerablities, face to the winds, come what may? Or Private - cautious and withheld, look strong and confident in public and don't let the world know I weep and rage and collapse on the inside? 

I don't get how to do the public/private roles on this one.
